before.answer: No address is documented as required before this fictional intake is complete. after.summary: A fictional intake now succeeds when policyReference, incidentSummary, and the customer-supplied mailing address are recorded, allowing a local review ticket only.
after.answer: The address that must be recorded before the fictional intake is complete is the customer-supplied mailing address: 42 Example Street, Demo City.
